title: Massachusetts's 4th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Massachusetts's 4th Congressional District will determine who represents a district that stretches from the Boston suburbs of Newton and Brookline south through Attleboro to Fall River. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Rep. Jake Auchincloss, first elected in 2020, faces a competitive Democratic primary challenge from AI researcher Jason Poulos, who is running on a platform of Medicare for All, universal basic income, and reducing corporate influence in politics. On the Republican side, physicist and entrepreneur Tom Stalcup is running on a platform focused on lowering prescription drug prices and reducing U.S. military intervention abroad. Independent candidate Steve Chasse is also in the race. The Democratic primary will be held September 1, 2026, and the general election is November 3, 2026.

candidates.name: Jake Auchincloss
candidates.summary: Jake Auchincloss is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Massachusetts's 4th Congressional District, first elected in 2020 and currently serving his third term. He is a former U.S. Marine Corps infantry officer who commanded troops in Afghanistan and special operations in Panama, and he served on the Newton City Council from 2015 to 2021. He serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and has focused on healthcare affordability, clean energy, gun violence prevention, and building a strong middle class.

candidates.name: Jason Poulos
candidates.summary: Jason Poulos is an AI researcher and policy analyst challenging incumbent Jake Auchincloss in the Democratic primary. He holds a PhD in Political Science with a Designated Emphasis in Computational Science and Engineering from UC Berkeley and has conducted postdoctoral research at Harvard Medical School and Brigham and Women's Hospital. His campaign focuses on AI-related worker displacement, Medicare for All, universal basic income, corporate taxes on automation, and reducing the influence of corporate money and political action committees in politics.

candidates.name: Tom Stalcup
candidates.summary: Tom Stalcup is a physicist, entrepreneur, and Republican candidate for Massachusetts's 4th Congressional District. He is president of an electronics company that designs and manufactures environmental monitoring systems used worldwide, and he previously conducted research at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory. He is running on a platform of lowering prescription drug prices by taking on pharmaceutical companies, reducing U.S. military intervention abroad, and putting evidence-based solutions ahead of partisan politics.

candidates.name: Steve Chasse
candidates.summary: Steve Chasse is an independent candidate running for U.S. House to represent Massachusetts's 4th Congressional District in the 2026 general election. He is a primary therapist specializing in recovery and substance use disorder treatment. Ballotpedia lists him as a declared candidate for the general election.
